current.text: Experts rate him a stable, low-upside late pick around round 11, a scoring boost at that point of the draft. He is worth more in deeper leagues.
It is unclear whether he starts for Memphis.
The Memphis forward group is crowded. Cameron Boozer will start, and Prosper, Hendricks, Edey and Stewart also compete for frontcourt minutes.
Coach Tuomas Iisalo runs an 11-man rotation with short stints. Joe expects only Cameron Boozer and Cedric Coward to top 30 minutes.
Joe expects Grant to be the go-to scorer when the young core gets stuck.
Joe thinks Grant will be motivated because he wants another big NBA contract.
Memphis has three first-round picks in the 2027 draft, which gives it room to make trades.
Grant is a possible trade chip at the deadline.
His 2P% should settle around 48 to 49 percent this season.

durable.text: He is a scorer first. He adds threes and points but gives little in rebounds and steals for a forward.
His FG% is weak for a forward on real volume, so he hurts team FG%.
He is a good free throw shooter.
His rim finishing has usually been in the mid-to-high 50s percent.
He has missed games in March and April in past seasons.
He has been much more available than Ja Morant.
